newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: M. Hill forecasts NZ$5.3-$5.5 mln yr net.
newsitem.headline: M. Hill forecasts NZ$5.3-$5.5 mln yr net.

text.p: Michael Hill International on Tuesday said it forecast a full-year net profit of between NZ$5.3 million and $5.5 million.
Michael Hill earlier announced a record tax-paid profit of $4.366 million for the six months to December 31, up 5.7 percent from $4.130 million in the previous comparable period.
"This positive result was achieved despite continuing difficult retail trading conditions in both Australia and New Zealand," Michael Hill said in a statement.
"The retail trading conditions in both Australia and New Zealand make forecasting our year end situation difficult. At this stage, our forecast profit position is in the $5.3 to $5.5 million range."
The company said it would continue with its strategy of controlled growth over the coming years. Emphasis would continue to be given to improving the profitability of existing stores.
"The directors remain confident in the continued growth and profitability of the group," Michael Hill said.
